Add Supplier Remarks to the surrogate bid form

plan.title: RFQ surrogate bid appears in QCS

steps.note: Open an existing event with an RFQ stage and a participating vendor eligible for a surrogate bid.
Navigate specifically to the RFQ stage required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage's Participants list where the vendor's Add Bid control is available.
Enter and submit the buyer-entered bid for the first eligible participating vendor.
Verify that the surrogate bid submission was accepted.
Verify the buyer's RFQ responses show at least one response and identify one as a Surrogate Bid.
Open the QCS after the surrogate bid is submitted.
Verify the QCS contains real vendor columns rather than placeholders.
Verify the surrogate vendor's RFQ rate cell is populated in the QCS.
